notes.title: Hotfix #1 Playtest v. 1.0.4
notes.content: [p]Hey Everyone,[/p][p]Hotfix #1 is out for the current Playtest v. 1.0.4[/p][p][/p][p]Fixed:[/p][p]- Graveyard level: Common Zombie enemies are now stopping as intended after taking damage.[/p]

notes.title: Playtest available
notes.content: [p]This first playtest is basicly to help us identify problems early, that may come with the newest changes and the current state of the game.[/p][p]It is a short first test to gather some feedback about the following topics:[/p][list][*][p]Gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]Difficulty[/p][/*][*][p]Bugs[/p][/*][*][p]Performance[/p][/*][*][p]Lightguns Settings (does the build in Rumble/Recoil work) [/p][/*][*][p]General Feedback & Suggestion[/p][/*][*][p]Level lenght[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]We are aware it is a little overtuned for the standard pistols. But we did this on purpose.[/p][p]All weapons and upgrades are available for you to test. Automatic weapons for example will make the level much easier to play.[/p][p][/p][p]The playtest will be extendet very soon.[/p][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy this first playtest, have fun and we look forward to your feedback.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Playtest delay
notes.content: [p]Hello together,[/p][p][/p][p]A short update about what happends and why we thought it is better to delay the planned playtest.[/p][p][/p][p]We added a new feature to the game we wanted to test.[/p][p]It is about traps, in the short video you can have a first glimse of the new feature.[/p][p][/p][p]The playtest level is almost finished, but still needs some rework.[/p][p] [/p][p]We will announce when the playtest be available for you to play very soon. So stay tuned.[/p][previewyoutube="T6QdsEWWPjE;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Playtest in preparation
notes.content:
We are currently preparing a first playtest.

It should be finished within the next 14 days.
For this first test we will make one playable level available. More levels will be added in later playtests.

Why we do this playtest?
[list]
[*] test gameplay
[*] finding bugs
[*] Performance
[*] Lightguns Settings (Rumble/Recoil)
[*] Feedback
[/list]

We will inform you the moment it is finished and available. So stay tuned.


A sneak peek for the upcoming playtest:
[previewyoutube=6HHiit9XSQQ;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: New Demo Version 2.0.1
notes.content:
I am proud to announce major update to the game.
This will hopefully be a great experience to play. And this is just the beginning of the upcoming updates that will follow frequently now.

[b]Whats new?[/b]
[olist]
Much more improved gore system
Enemy models
Improved corsshairs
Feedback on shooting
Points for dismembering
Improved response to damage you take
[/olist]
Already working on much more updates like a the display of the points at the impact point, a timerun option and much more.
So stay tuned and have fun with the new version of the demo.

notes.title: Demo Version 1.0.2 available
notes.content:
The extended version of the demo (v1.0.2) is now available.

[b]Changelog[/b]:
[list]
[*] Longer demo level
[*] Improved projectile hitbox.
[*] Reload animation: Added option to show/hide reload animation.
[*] Added selectable crosshair: Standard, point and show/hide crosshair.
[*] Changed the layout of the "You are Dead" menu.
[*] Added new flying enemy type.
[/list]
Enjoy the hunt and thank you for playing the demo.

notes.title: New Demo Version 1.0.2 soon available.
notes.content:
[b]New Demo (Version 1.0.2) soon available.[/b]

Currently we are working on version 1.0.2 of the demo.

We want to thank all who have played the demo and provide feedback from lots of different sources. This way it is possible to make a way better game.

Based on the feedback we have recived over the last few days we have finished the following. These additions and imporvements will be in the new demo version 1.0.2.

[b]Done:[/b]
- Improvement on hitting enemy projectiles (thrown weapons of the enemies)
- Reload options: Show/hide reload animation
- Crosshair options: Show/Hide crosshair. Select standart or small dot crosshair.
- Changed the layout of the "You are Dead" menu.
- Added new flying enemy.

[b]To Do:[/b]
- Longer, extendet demo.

As soon as we have finished a extendet version demo, we will inform you.
This should hopefully take only a few days more.

We also decidet to have a demo available for download after the steam fest.
